name: @equin/plugin-apps-deploy-analytics-host-only
description: Routes reachable only from the deployed box itself, and the guards every public route of a deployed site shares: the /api/host-only/ prefix Caddy refuses publicly, the hostOnly(handler) second guard (404 unless the request made exactly one proxy hop), requestClientIp(req) — the one place that knows the Caddy → gateway → backend X-Forwarded-For chain —, capBodySize (refuse an oversized public body before reading it) and isBotUserAgent.
